description: This file is a shell script used for testing globbing performance in Git. It sets up a series of glob patterns and reference files, and then runs performance tests comparing globbing methods against these references.

methods.name: test_perf_fresh_repo
methods.description: Initializes a fresh Git repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test comparing globbing methods.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Finalizes and concludes the test suite.
